title: 次の階へ
change: 報酬を三人で分け、コウの分は新しい育苗容器と店の仕事に使う。バルトは採集種を小区画で試験する。ギルドから次の五階調査へ指名され、店と遠征の役割分担を継続。五階到達や新作物収穫は次話以降。
state: 報酬を三人で分け、コウの分は新しい育苗容器と店の仕事に使う。バルトは採集種を小区画で試験する。ギルドから次の五階調査へ指名され、店と遠征の役割分担を継続。五階到達や新作物収穫は次話以降。

sources.description: Morning51 dry guild or diner back desk, Row Sera Kou split modest reward into three small pouches fairly, Leon absent unless desk clerk generic. Small coin hands then Kou realizes he earned field-work reward personally.
dialogue:
三人の仕事だ
報酬も分けよう

俺が
攻略で稼いだんだ
sources.scrollPurpose: 行動と反応をつなぎ成果を受け止める

sources.description: Outside garden workbench Balt identifies sample as a locally known but rare fourth-floor water-vein herb only tentatively by pod, compares remembered features; Kou listens. Leaf sample not eaten, mature seeds not instant sprouts. No invention of huge yield today.
dialogue:
水脈葉に
似ているな

小さく試す
まずはそこからだ
sources.scrollPurpose: 行動と反応をつなぎ成果を受け止める

sources.description: Kou and Elna buy simple sturdy shallow nursery trays from ordinary maker with earned money, Iris checks removable clean base and drainage holes. One concrete purchased tool, no industrial greenhouse instantly.
dialogue:
道具を
買えるんだね

手入れできる物が
いい

次に育てるための
仕事に使おう
sources.scrollPurpose: 行動と反応をつなぎ成果を受け止める

sources.description: Small separated nursery comparison trays at garden edge, Kou and Balt sow a few seeds and attach simple blank-mark tags; hand placing seed, moist but not saturated soil, empty other tray control. No mature magical crop or green sprouts in this same scene.
dialogue:
採って終わりじゃ
ないんだな

ここからが
農夫の仕事だ
sources.scrollPurpose: 行動と反応をつなぎ成果を受け止める

sources.description: Same diner modest line now with returning guild adventurers discussing expedition, Kou hears local adult praises practical accomplishment; Elna serves same steady normal menu. Rodel at side nods respect while visiting as paying customer, not humiliated servant.
dialogue:
四階を通した
農夫の店だろ

今度は
皿だけではないのか
sources.scrollPurpose: 行動と反応をつなぎ成果を受け止める

sources.description: Leon returns to quiet dry diner table with Row and a simple folded fifth-floor route sketch. Kou receives personal invitation, Elna alongside as business equal. No completed five-floor conquest, no definitive harvest of new seeds.
dialogue:
次は五階の
調査に来てほしい

君の見方が
必要だ
sources.scrollPurpose: 行動と反応をつなぎ成果を受け止める

sources.description: Elna and Kou plan simple weekly work tokens with Balt taking farm role and Row/Sera expedition role, small paired practical gestures then a large confident Kou accepting travel. Food delivery six twice weekly distinct from normal16sales, no unlimited expansion.
dialogue:
店は
続けていこう

ああ
畑も増やして
もっと上へ行く
sources.scrollPurpose: 行動と反応をつなぎ成果を受け止める

sources.description: Final flowing borderless tableau: in foreground modest freshly sown tray with no sprouts, middle same blue-awning busy diner, upper distant towering stairway inside luminous vault. Kou and Elna look upward beside store, Row and Sera wait at foot of stairs, earned warm hope, not royal coronation or final ending.
dialogue:
育てたものが
道を開く
sources.scrollPurpose: 小さな種と大きな塔を結び次の冒険へ余韻を残す
